entries.title: Mark 12:1
segments: And he began to speak unto them in parables. A man planted a vineyard, and set a hedge about it, and digged a pit for the winepress, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into another country.

entries.title: Mark 12:2
segments: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruits of the vineyard.

entries.title: Mark 12:3
segments: And they took him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.

entries.title: Mark 12:4
segments: And again he sent unto them another servant; and him they wounded in the head, and handled shamefully.

entries.title: Mark 12:5
segments: And he sent another; and him they killed: and many others; beating some, and killing some.

entries.title: Mark 12:6
segments: He had yet one, a beloved son: he sent him last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.

entries.title: Mark 12:7
segments: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.

entries.title: Mark 12:8
segments: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him forth out of the vineyard.

entries.title: Mark 12:9
segments: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.

entries.title: Mark 12:10
segments: Have ye not read even this scripture: The stone which the builders rejected, The same was made the head of the corner;

entries.title: Mark 12:11
segments: This was from the Lord, And it is marvellous in our eyes?

entries.title: Mark 12:12
segments: And they sought to lay hold on him; and they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spake the parable against them: and they left him, and went away.

entries.title: Mark 12:13
segments: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, that they might catch him in talk.

entries.title: Mark 12:14
segments: And when they were come, they say unto him, Teacher, we know that thou art true, and carest not for any one; for thou regardest not the person of men, but of a truth teachest the way of God: Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?

entries.title: Mark 12:15
segments: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why make ye trial of me? bring me a denarius, that I may see it.

entries.title: Mark 12:16
segments: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.

entries.title: Mark 12:17
segments: And Jesus said unto them, Render unto Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and unto God the things that are God's. And they marvelled greatly at him.

entries.title: Mark 12:18
segments: And there come unto him Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,

entries.title: Mark 12:19
segments: Teacher, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave a wife behind him, and leave no child, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

entries.title: Mark 12:20
segments: There were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed;

entries.title: Mark 12:21
segments: and the second took her, and died, leaving no seed behind him; and the third likewise:

entries.title: Mark 12:22
segments: and the seven left no seed. Last of all the woman also died.

entries.title: Mark 12:23
segments: In the resurrection whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.

entries.title: Mark 12:24
segments: Jesus said unto them, Is it not for this cause that ye err, that ye know not the scriptures, nor the power of God?

entries.title: Mark 12:25
segments: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as angels in heaven.

entries.title: Mark 12:26
segments: But as touching the dead, that they are raised; have ye not read in the book of Moses, in [the place concerning] the Bush, how God spake unto him, saying, I [am] the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?

entries.title: Mark 12:27
segments: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living: ye do greatly err.

entries.title: Mark 12:28
segments: And one of the scribes came, and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, What commandment is the first of all?

entries.title: Mark 12:29
segments: Jesus answered, The first is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God, the Lord is one:

entries.title: Mark 12:30
segments: and thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength.

entries.title: Mark 12:31
segments: The second is this, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.

entries.title: Mark 12:32
segments: And the scribe said unto him, Of a truth, Teacher, thou hast well said that he is one; and there is none other but he:

entries.title: Mark 12:33
segments: and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is much more than all whole burnt-offerings and sacrifices.

entries.title: Mark 12:34
segments: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.

entries.title: Mark 12:35
segments: And Jesus answered and said, as he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that the Christ is the son of David?

entries.title: Mark 12:36
segments: David himself said in the Holy Spirit, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, Till I make thine enemies the footstool of thy feet.

entries.title: Mark 12:37
segments: David himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he his son? And the common people heard him gladly.

entries.title: Mark 12:38
segments: And in his teaching he said, Beware of the scribes, who desire to walk in long robes, and [to have] salutations in the marketplaces,

entries.title: Mark 12:39
segments: and chief seats in the synagogues, and chief places at feasts:

entries.title: Mark 12:40
segments: they that devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers; these shall receive greater condemnation.

entries.title: Mark 12:41
segments: And he sat down over against the treasury, and beheld how the multitude cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.

entries.title: Mark 12:42
segments: And there came a poor widow, and she cast in two mites, which make a farthing.

entries.title: Mark 12:43
segments: And he called unto him his disciples, and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, This poor widow cast in more than all they that are casting into the treasury:

entries.title: Mark 12:44
segments: for they all did cast in of their superfluity; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, [even] all her living.
